marketing.ttl: Aldi 用「玫瑰色色卡钥匙扣」把选酒变成可分享梗
marketing.sum: Aldi 推出限量 Rosé Swatch 钥匙扣，把消费者选玫瑰酒色的真实怪癖变成可视化、有用又好分享的周边，品牌味十足。
marketing.body: Aldi estimates collective rosé colour preferences cause £103M of wine to be rejected yearly; its Rosé Swatch keyring turns the quirk into a shareable, useful object. Lesson: build marketing around a truth your audience already has.
marketing.note: 海外案例，适合做『把消费者怪癖变传播梗』的创意参照。

marketing.ttl: 麦当劳×小玉 yuy：把「东南亚超值季」做成一场感官出逃
marketing.sum: 麦当劳携手治愈系原创 IP 小玉 yuy 任「东南亚美味领队」，用明信片/徽章/托特包等生活化衍生品把 IP 温度融进日常，多轮互动制造稀缺与参与感。
marketing.body: 麦当劳×小玉 yuy 东南亚超值季：用高饱和异域包装+生活化周边+预约尝新会，把『没假期的情绪低谷』补上一场夏日仪式感，IP 不靠盲盒摆件而靠日常场景渗透。
marketing.note: IP 联名靠日常场景渗透而非摆件，值得借鉴。

marketing.ttl: Fanta 遇 AI 反噬 vs Apple 反向自证：创意里 AI 的信任红线
marketing.sum: Fanta 建原创万圣 IP「Haunted Universe」被批「AI slop」；Apple 则主动放出幕后花絮自证非 AI 生成，把「制作过程」本身变成创意资产。
marketing.body: Fanta's AI-built Halloween universe sparked backlash as 'AI slop'; Apple released BTS footage to prove its ad wasn't AI-generated—transparency becomes a creative asset.
marketing.note: AI 创意的舆论敏感度上升，『是否用 AI』已成传播变量。

marketing.ttl: Pizza Hut 把自己改名「Hut」，把品牌名当创意钩子
marketing.sum: Pizza Hut 8/31 前暂称「Hut」，借橄榄球口令「hut, hut, hike」把品牌名本身做成可跨广告/社媒/体育文化的短钩子。
marketing.body: Pizza Hut becomes simply 'Hut' through Aug 31, tying the stunt to football season and the quarterback cadence 'hut, hut, hike'—using the brand name itself as the creative idea.
marketing.note: 短期、高辨识度文化时刻借势，比常规产品广告更易起量。

marketing.ttl: Brand Strategy 2026：authenticity 回潮，AI 内容信任度半年跌 18%
marketing.sum: 报告指 AI 生成品牌内容消费者信任度半年降 18%，微网红互动率高出 72%，3–5 秒短视频占品牌互动时长 61%。
marketing.body: Pew (Jul 2026): trust in AI-generated brand content dropped 18% in six months; micro-influencers drove 72% higher engagement; 3–5s loops = 61% of brand interaction time.
marketing.note: 2026 营销主线：从效率优先回到真实与人味。

tech.ttl: OpenAI 广告业务年化收入破 10 亿美元，上线约 200 天

tech.note: 超级 App 免费流量变现路径清晰，利好内容平台广告逻辑。

tech.ttl: OpenClaw 2.0 发布：长期记忆 + 多 Agent 协作

tech.ttl: 工信部启动 AI 应用服务商培育专项行动，年底资源池破 2000 家

听.title: BBC 6 Minute English: How do we describe smells?
听.body: Presenter: What is the worst smell in the world? And what is the best smell? Are there any smells you like, but your friends or family hate? Smells are all around us all the time, but the English language is often quite general in the way it describes smells, as opposed to other senses like sounds or tastes. But why is this? Neil and Georgie discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary. (Episode ep-260827, published 27 Aug 2026. Full transcript, worksheet & quiz at bbc.co.uk/learningenglish.)
听.zh: 本期话题：我们如何描述气味？英语在描述气味时往往比其他感官（声音、味道）更笼统——为什么会这样？主持 Neil 与 Georgie 边聊边教你新词汇。听后试着用英语说出「一种你喜欢但别人讨厌的气味」，并记下节目里学到的 3 个新词。

说.title: 口语话题：Describe a smell that brings back a memory
说.source: 原创 · WorkBuddy 每日英语
说.body: Speaking task: Think of a smell that instantly brings back a memory for you. Prepare a 60-second talk: 1) What is the smell? 2) When do you notice it? 3) What memory does it trigger, and why is it special? Use sensory adjectives (e.g. faint, pungent, comforting, musty). Record yourself and note one phrase you want to reuse.
说.zh: 口语练习：想一种能瞬间唤起你某段记忆的气味。准备一段 60 秒发言：①是什么气味？②你通常在什么场景闻到？③它唤起了什么回忆、为何特别？用上感官形容词（faint 淡淡的、pungent 刺鼻的、comforting 令人安心的、musty 发霉味的）。录下来并记一个想复用的表达。

读.title: Alibaba's Qwen becomes world's most downloaded open AI model
读.body: Alibaba's Qwen has become the world's most-downloaded open AI model family, surpassing rivals from Meta and Google as its cumulative global downloads topped 3 billion, underscoring the growing reach of Chinese open-source AI among developers worldwide. A report on the state of open models published by AI platform Hugging Face showed Qwen models recorded about 2.045 billion downloads on the Hugging Face Hub in 2026, compared to about 418 million for Google's models and 227 million for Meta's. Those figures cover only downloads from Hugging Face and exclude other platforms — including China's ModelScope — meaning that they differ from Qwen's more than 3 billion cumulative global downloads across all platforms.
读.zh: 阿里巴巴 Qwen 已成为全球下载量最大的开源 AI 模型家族，累计全球下载突破 30 亿次，超越 Meta 与 Google。Hugging Face 报告显示，2026 年 Qwen 在 Hub 上下载约 20.45 亿次，而 Google 约 4.18 亿、Meta 约 2.27 亿（仅计 Hugging Face，未含 ModelScope 等平台）。这凸显中国开源 AI 在全球开发者中的影响力持续扩大。

写.title: 写作任务：The rise of open-source AI
写.source: 原创 · WorkBuddy 每日英语
写.body: Writing task (150–200 words): 'Open-source AI models are reshaping who builds the future of technology.' Do you agree? Give two reasons and one example (you may use the Qwen story from today's reading). End with your own prediction for 2027.
写.zh: 写作任务（150–200 词）：『开源 AI 模型正在重塑谁来控制技术的未来。』你同意吗？给出两个理由和一个例子（可用今日阅读里的 Qwen 故事），并以你对 2027 年的预测收尾。

练.title: 词汇/语法练习：Sense verbs & adjectives
练.source: 原创 · WorkBuddy 每日英语
练.body: Practice: Fill the gaps with a suitable adjective of smell/taste/sound. 1) The coffee smelled _____ (nice / nicely). 2) That cheese has a _____ (sharply / sharp) odour. 3) Her voice sounded _____ (calm / calmly) on the phone. 4) The soup tasted _____ (good / well). → Check: after sense verbs (smell, sound, taste, look, feel) we use an adjective, not an adverb.
练.zh: 练习：用合适的气味/味道/声音形容词填空。1) The coffee smelled _____. 2) That cheese has a _____ odour. 3) Her voice sounded _____ on the phone. 4) The soup tasted _____. → 要点：smell/sound/taste/look/feel 这类感官动词后接形容词，不接副词。
